title: Echo Form
description: The first card you play each turn is played an extra time.
smart_description: The first card you play each turn is played an extra time. (Pluralizes based on counter: 'The first [Amount] cards you play each turn are played an extra time.' when stacked.)
notes: This is a Counter-type buff where the stack count determines how many cards per turn will be echoed. When you have 1 stack, only the first card is echoed. With multiple stacks, the first N cards (where N equals the counter value) are echoed each turn.
